PROP-078 status=implemented; structure-integrity.md carries the language (lines 59/293/599); decider.md line 39 carries the explicit principle. Directive stayed status=pending in git.
findings.root_cause: FND-01 write-side trap (read-side already guarded in the dispatcher, write-side was not): operator-directives/ is append_only in build.js OWNERSHIP, so build.js sync-workspace's walkAppendOnly skips existing files. A status flip written to FUSE by the completing run never propagates to git; the directive stays git-pending. The completing runs (2026-06-03, 2026-06-07) did the substantive work and authored the PROPs but their Step-9 flip either targeted FUSE or was never pushed.
findings.resolution: Both directives flipped to status=completed this run (completed_by_run=tinker-2026-06-14T07-54, prop_id_authored set, progress note documenting OBE). Flip written from the git clone and pushed, not FUSE.
findings.self_fix: Hardened tinker.md dispatcher flip instruction (line 123) to mandate clone-write+push for directive lifecycle flips, citing both stranded directives as the canonical failure shape. Prevents recurrence.

self_fixes_applied.change: Added write-side FND-01 guard to the directive-completion-flip bullet (line 123): flips MUST be written from the git clone and pushed, never FUSE, because append_only sync skips existing files. ~1 sentence + failure-shape citation.
